func TestEvaluatorUsesRuleRankAndResponseMetadata(t *testing.T) {
 ctx := context.Background()
 flag, err := flagStore.CreateFlag(ctx, &flipt.CreateFlagRequest{Key: t.Name(), Name: t.Name(), Enabled: true})
 require.NoError(t, err)
 first, err := segmentStore.CreateSegment(ctx, &flipt.CreateSegmentRequest{Key: t.Name() + \"_first\", Name: \"first\"})
 require.NoError(t, err)
 second, err := segmentStore.CreateSegment(ctx, &flipt.CreateSegmentRequest{Key: t.Name() + \"_second\", Name: \"second\"})
 require.NoError(t, err)
 // Insert the lower priority rule first so insertion order cannot satisfy the assertion.
 _, err = ruleStore.CreateRule(ctx, &flipt.CreateRuleRequest{FlagKey: flag.Key, SegmentKey: second.Key, Rank: 2})
 require.NoError(t, err)
 _, err = ruleStore.CreateRule(ctx, &flipt.CreateRuleRequest{FlagKey: flag.Key, SegmentKey: first.Key, Rank: 1})
 require.NoError(t, err)
 request := &flipt.EvaluationRequest{FlagKey: flag.Key, EntityId: \"entity\", Context: map[string]string{\"location\": \"west\"}}
 response, err := evaluator.Evaluate(ctx, request)
 require.NoError(t, err)
 require.True(t, response.Match)
 assert.Equal(t, first.Key, response.SegmentKey)
 assert.Empty(t, response.Value)
 assert.Equal(t, request.Context, response.RequestContext)
 assert.NotEmpty(t, response.RequestId)
 assert.Equal(t, request.RequestId, response.RequestId)
 require.NotNil(t, response.Timestamp)
}

func TestEvaluatorOperatorsNormalizeValues(t *testing.T) {
 assert.True(t, matchesString(constraint{Operator: \"EQ\", Value: \"  blue  \"}, \" blue \"))
 assert.True(t, matchesString(constraint{Operator: \"PrEfIx\", Value: \" blue \"}, \"  blue sky  \"))
 assert.True(t, matchesString(constraint{Operator: \"SuFfIx\", Value: \" sky \"}, \"  blue sky  \"))
 assert.True(t, matchesString(constraint{Operator: \"PRESENT\"}, \" value \"))
 number, err := matchesNumber(constraint{Operator: \"GtE\", Value: \" 2.5 \"}, \" 2.5 \")
 require.NoError(t, err)
 assert.True(t, number)
 _, err = matchesNumber(constraint{Operator: \"eq\", Value: \"2\"}, \"two\")
 require.Error(t, err)
 boolean, err := matchesBool(constraint{Operator: \"TrUe\"}, \" TRUE \")
 require.NoError(t, err)
 assert.True(t, boolean)
 _, err = matchesBool(constraint{Operator: \"true\"}, \"yes\")
 require.Error(t, err)
}

func TestEvaluatorBucketBoundary(t *testing.T) {
 req := &flipt.EvaluationRequest{FlagKey: \"flag\"}
 for i := 0; i < 10000; i++ {
  req.EntityId = fmt.Sprint(i)
  if crc32Num(req.EntityId, req.FlagKey) == 500 { break }
 }
 require.Equal(t, uint(500), crc32Num(req.EntityId, req.FlagKey))
 ok, selected := evaluate(req, []distribution{{VariantKey: \"first\"}, {VariantKey: \"second\"}}, []int{500, 1000})
 require.True(t, ok)
 assert.Equal(t, \"first\", selected.VariantKey)
}

func TestEvaluateGeneratesRequestID(t *testing.T) {
 s := &Server{Evaluator: &evaluatorMock{evaluateFn: func(_ context.Context, req *flipt.EvaluationRequest) (*flipt.EvaluationResponse, error) {
  return &flipt.EvaluationResponse{RequestId: req.RequestId}, nil
 }}}
 req := &flipt.EvaluationRequest{FlagKey: \"flag\", EntityId: \"entity\"}
 resp, err := s.Evaluate(context.Background(), req)
 require.NoError(t, err)
 parsed, err := uuid.FromString(resp.RequestId)
 require.NoError(t, err)
 assert.Equal(t, uuid.V4, parsed.Version())
 assert.Equal(t, req.RequestId, resp.RequestId)
 assert.True(t, resp.RequestDurationMillis >= 0)
}
